_meta: STATIC, DOCTOR-APPROVED TEXT. No LLM-generated content. EN wording needs doctor sign-off.
refusal: I'm sorry, I am unable to provide medical diagnoses or prescriptions. Please consult a doctor. I can still help with approved topics, such as clinic information and general health information from our approved sources.
fallback: I'm sorry, I don't have information about that. Please ask the clinic or your doctor directly.
unavailable: The assistant is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly, or contact the clinic.
availability_none: No doctors have available slots on {date}.
